answer: Pick no more than five projects for the first serious pass: one North Flagler waterfront option, one branded-service option, one Downtown walkability option, one South Flagler option, and one boutique or pipeline wildcard. Then compare the same facts across all five: live inventory, floorplan, view, timing, carrying cost, parking, service model, and exit liquidity.
